changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.8.1:

• 🗣️ Background Spoken Greetings & Voice Playback: Fixed background wake response so JARVIS speaks aloud ('Hi Sir, how can I help you?') and answers commands when woken from the background/recents-swiped state.

• ⚡ Instant Follow-Up Window: Automatically activates conversation follow-up upon wake detection so subsequent questions or commands are processed without requiring wake word repetitions.

• 🛡️ Anti-Flutter TV Noise Debouncer: Retains 2-frame debouncing and common TV distractors to eliminate spontaneous activations.
